assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent 2D character animation sprite sheet for an app. Reference image is the exact Alice character identity: preserve her blue/periwinkle fluffy hair, blue eyes, whale-shaped hood, whale hairclip, navy/cream hoodie, bow, skirt, opaque socks, shoes and whale tail. Full-body cute chibi, clean anime linework and cel shading. Every cell contains exactly one COMPLETE character, same size, same camera, same baseline, consistent proportions. Center each character in its own equally sized cell with generous transparent padding; nothing crosses cell boundaries. Real transparent background, no scenery, floor, shadows, text, borders, grid lines, frame labels, extra characters or props unless specified. This is a temporal sprite animation sheet; frames progress left to right within each row. Keep her body position steady and do the motion primarily with arms, eyes, head and tail. Canvas aspect ratio 2:1. EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS AND TWO ROWS, total 8 cells. Top row: 4-frame quiet idle breathing/blinking loop: relaxed hands near front, eyes open; soft half-blink; eyes gently closed; eyes open again. Bottom row: 4-frame attentive listening loop: hands gently together, head subtly tilts toward viewer, attentive open eyes; tiny nod; soft blink; return. Listening should be visually distinct from idle. No waving in these two rows.
